about: Public change records for the Timeline page, written for readers. One record per change; never edited after its revision is released. Rules: docs/concepts/TIMELINE-INBOX-AND-CHANGES-PROPOSAL.md.

changes.text: Added the conventional Big Five mass extinctions on the deep-time axis, placed on the ICS chart (v2026-06).
The Pliny entry (on this page since 9 Nov 2026) moved into the catalogue. It stays on the dates-without-a-year shelf.

changes.title: Wording clarified: End-Triassic mass extinction.

before.label: Approximate age of the extinction horizon
before.text: In all three sections studied, a large sulfur-isotope shift at about 201.5 million years ago coincides with the extinction horizon.

after.label: Approximate age of the extinction level in the rock record
after.text: In each of the three sections studied, a large sulfur-isotope shift about 201.5 million years ago coincides with the level in the rock record that marks the extinction.

changes.why: plainer wording for a general reader
changes.unchanged: Dates, sources and the mark on the axis are unchanged.
